$comment: Accepted production audit advisories, enforced by scripts/audit-gate.js (npm run audit). An advisory is accepted only if every production path to the vulnerable package goes through one of the listed `via` dependency chains. Keep in sync with SECURITY.md.

allowlist.reason: Transitive dependencies of yeoman-generator@5 (latest 5.x, required by @adobe/generator-app-common-lib@3): tar, pacote, sigstore, yeoman-environment, @octokit/*, @tootallnate/once, glob, minimatch. Fixes require the yeoman-generator@7 / ESM migration. This code runs only on the developer machine while `aio app init` generates the project; the generator never installs or extracts packages through pacote/yeoman-environment and nothing from it is deployed to Adobe I/O Runtime.

Low severity prototype poisoning of merge results in deepmerge, used by @adobe/aio-lib-core-config to merge local aio config files. No fixed deepmerge version is available; inputs are trusted local configuration.
